findings.text: the fragment states the base and head runs were made as jobs on all_debug with SLURM_JOB_ID unset, but neither base-negative-control.log nor head-run.log carries a host or partition header, while the facility suite and scoped-gate logs do carry a '# host:' header, so the done_when's environment qualifier is claimed rather than recorded; have those two runs written through the wrapper that stamps revision, tree and host so a later reader can re-run the qualifier.
